name: Emerson Manufacturing
old_description: Emerson Manufacturing: Air Jacks, Cylinder Locks, Air Hydraulic Jacks, and More
about:
Emerson Manufacturing Corporation, based in Pender, Nebraska, has been a family-owned-and-operated business since 1960. The company began as a fabricator of professional truck shop service equipment and remains under family stewardship today.

The firm manufactures a range of air hydraulic jacks, cylinder locks, and related shop equipment. Its product line includes Air Jack Models 110 and 220 for lifting trailers, tractors, and other equipment during tire and brake maintenance, as well as CL-30 Safety Cylinder Locks that can be removed and reused. Emerson also produces bottle jacks, axle jacks, farm service jacks, fluid transfer systems, truck ramps, vehicle support stands, filter crushers, and transmission jacks. Every unit is tested before it leaves the warehouse, and the company maintains a stock of service and repair parts to minimize customer downtime.

Primary customers are automotive and heavy-duty truck repair shops, diesel mechanics, and agricultural operations that service trailers and tractors. The equipment is sold directly to professional mechanics and through distribution channels serving the truck shop market.

Emerson emphasizes that all products are 100 percent made in the USA and highlights its reusable cylinder lock design as a differentiator. The company cites its commitment to testing every item, lifetime service support, and a parts inventory that keeps shops running as reasons customers choose its equipment.
